request.instructions: Make it pick up seed fast but don't make it so you can reach top speed fast

vehicleTypeReason: The vehicle is explicitly marked with FLAG_LAW_ENFORCEMENT, FLAG_EMERGENCY_SERVICE, and uses sheriff-specific driver and cover metadata.

security.summary: The pack contains only vehicle assets and standard metadata, with no scripts, web content, executables, or other runtime behavior. No security concerns were found.

remediation.summary: Quarantine the uploaded manifest because it is the only listed file and it contains a runtime script declaration, which is not permitted for this vehicle pack importer.

actions.reason: Removing the manifest eliminates the referenced client script declaration and prevents any runtime-script behavior from being carried forward into the repackaged vehicle-only asset set.
